# Entity Preflight rules

<!-- Generated from preflight/rules.go by `go test ./preflight -update`. Do not edit by hand. -->

Entity Preflight checks a candidate Lattice entity against these rules before it is published. They encode Anduril's public integration guide and the field comments in the Go SDK, and were checked against lattice-sdk-go v5.5.0. Every link is pinned to the commit or tag the rule was read from. The enum rule asks the installed SDK which values exist, and the known-fields rule asks it which fields do, so neither keeps a copy of Anduril's lists.

The documentation can lag the server, so passing preflight is necessary, not sufficient. `takgw readback -live` publishes test entities to a real environment and reads them back, which is the final word.

## Errors

The documentation says the server rejects or discards the entity, or that the field is required, or the value is outside what the field can mean. `takgw preflight` exits 1 when any entity breaks one.

| Rule | Requires | Sources |
|---|---|---|
| `entity-id` | entityId is set and non-empty. It is the upsert key, so it must also be stable across republishes. | [Integration guide: Required for a live entity](https://github.com/anduril/lattice-sdk-ai/blob/7a376d8188a874e2dfeccc85847edbc153aac562/lattice-plugin/skills/lattice-sdk-integration/references/entity-fields.md#required-for-a-live-entity)<br>[Go SDK v5.5.0: Entity.EntityID](https://github.com/anduril/lattice-sdk-go/blob/v5.5.0/types.go#L4579-L4582) |
| `is-live` | isLive is true. | [Integration guide: Required for a live entity](https://github.com/anduril/lattice-sdk-ai/blob/7a376d8188a874e2dfeccc85847edbc153aac562/lattice-plugin/skills/lattice-sdk-integration/references/entity-fields.md#required-for-a-live-entity)<br>[Go SDK v5.5.0: Entity.IsLive](https://github.com/anduril/lattice-sdk-go/blob/v5.5.0/types.go#L4587-L4590) |
| `expiry-set` | expiryTime is set, unless noExpiry is true. | [Integration guide: Required for a live entity](https://github.com/anduril/lattice-sdk-ai/blob/7a376d8188a874e2dfeccc85847edbc153aac562/lattice-plugin/skills/lattice-sdk-integration/references/entity-fields.md#required-for-a-live-entity)<br>[Go SDK v5.5.0: Entity.ExpiryTime and NoExpiry](https://github.com/anduril/lattice-sdk-go/blob/v5.5.0/types.go#L4597-L4611) |
| `expiry-in-future` | expiryTime is after the current time. | [Integration guide: Required for a live entity](https://github.com/anduril/lattice-sdk-ai/blob/7a376d8188a874e2dfeccc85847edbc153aac562/lattice-plugin/skills/lattice-sdk-integration/references/entity-fields.md#required-for-a-live-entity)<br>[Go SDK v5.5.0: Entity.ExpiryTime and NoExpiry](https://github.com/anduril/lattice-sdk-go/blob/v5.5.0/types.go#L4597-L4611) |
| `expiry-within-30-days` | expiryTime is less than 30 days after the current time. | [Integration guide: Required for a live entity](https://github.com/anduril/lattice-sdk-ai/blob/7a376d8188a874e2dfeccc85847edbc153aac562/lattice-plugin/skills/lattice-sdk-integration/references/entity-fields.md#required-for-a-live-entity)<br>[Go SDK v5.5.0: Entity.ExpiryTime and NoExpiry](https://github.com/anduril/lattice-sdk-go/blob/v5.5.0/types.go#L4597-L4611) |
| `provenance-integration-name` | provenance.integrationName is set and non-empty. | [Integration guide: Required for a live entity](https://github.com/anduril/lattice-sdk-ai/blob/7a376d8188a874e2dfeccc85847edbc153aac562/lattice-plugin/skills/lattice-sdk-integration/references/entity-fields.md#required-for-a-live-entity)<br>[Integration guide: Provenance](https://github.com/anduril/lattice-sdk-ai/blob/7a376d8188a874e2dfeccc85847edbc153aac562/lattice-plugin/skills/lattice-sdk-integration/references/entity-fields.md#provenance-provenance) |
| `provenance-data-type` | provenance.dataType is set and non-empty. The guide's field table lists only integrationName as required, but its example server error is "provenance.dataType must be set", so this follows the server. | [Integration guide: Required for a live entity](https://github.com/anduril/lattice-sdk-ai/blob/7a376d8188a874e2dfeccc85847edbc153aac562/lattice-plugin/skills/lattice-sdk-integration/references/entity-fields.md#required-for-a-live-entity)<br>[Integration guide: Provenance](https://github.com/anduril/lattice-sdk-ai/blob/7a376d8188a874e2dfeccc85847edbc153aac562/lattice-plugin/skills/lattice-sdk-integration/references/entity-fields.md#provenance-provenance) |
| `display-name` | aliases.name is set and non-empty: it is the display name operators see. | [Integration guide: Required for a live entity](https://github.com/anduril/lattice-sdk-ai/blob/7a376d8188a874e2dfeccc85847edbc153aac562/lattice-plugin/skills/lattice-sdk-integration/references/entity-fields.md#required-for-a-live-entity)<br>[Integration guide: Required by template](https://github.com/anduril/lattice-sdk-ai/blob/7a376d8188a874e2dfeccc85847edbc153aac562/lattice-plugin/skills/lattice-sdk-integration/references/entity-fields.md#required-by-template) |
| `enum-values` | Every enum field the model carries (milView disposition and environment, ontology.template, the classification level, and an asset's health and sensor statuses and sensor types) holds a value the installed SDK knows, and not an INVALID sentinel. The server rejects an unknown value with UNMARSHAL_ERROR. | [Integration guide: the Any-typed enum trap](https://github.com/anduril/lattice-sdk-ai/blob/7a376d8188a874e2dfeccc85847edbc153aac562/lattice-plugin/skills/lattice-sdk-integration/references/enums.md)<br>[Integration guide: Choosing values](https://github.com/anduril/lattice-sdk-ai/blob/7a376d8188a874e2dfeccc85847edbc153aac562/lattice-plugin/skills/lattice-sdk-integration/references/enums.md#choosing-values)<br>[Go SDK v5.5.0: types.go](https://github.com/anduril/lattice-sdk-go/blob/v5.5.0/types.go) |
| `template-fields` | A TEMPLATE_TRACK or TEMPLATE_ASSET entity has ontology.platformType, location.position latitude and longitude, and milView disposition and environment. | [Integration guide: Required by template](https://github.com/anduril/lattice-sdk-ai/blob/7a376d8188a874e2dfeccc85847edbc153aac562/lattice-plugin/skills/lattice-sdk-integration/references/entity-fields.md#required-by-template) |
| `position-range` | location.position is a WGS84 position: latitude within [-90, 90], longitude within [-180, 180], and finite numbers throughout. | [Go SDK v5.5.0: Position](https://github.com/anduril/lattice-sdk-go/blob/v5.5.0/types.go#L13679-L13687) |
| `track-quality-range` | tracked.trackQualityWrapper, when set, is from 0 to 15. | [Go SDK v5.5.0: Tracked.TrackQualityWrapper](https://github.com/anduril/lattice-sdk-go/blob/v5.5.0/types.go#L18210-L18211)<br>[Integration guide: Track quality](https://github.com/anduril/lattice-sdk-ai/blob/7a376d8188a874e2dfeccc85847edbc153aac562/lattice-plugin/skills/lattice-sdk-integration/references/entity-fields.md#track-quality--tracked) |
| `source-update-time-changes` | provenance.sourceUpdateTime differs from the same entity's previous update; Entity Manager discards an update whose time didn't change. Checked across the entities given, in order. | [Go SDK v5.5.0: Provenance.SourceUpdateTime](https://github.com/anduril/lattice-sdk-go/blob/v5.5.0/types.go#L14672-L14676)<br>[Integration guide: Provenance](https://github.com/anduril/lattice-sdk-ai/blob/7a376d8188a874e2dfeccc85847edbc153aac562/lattice-plugin/skills/lattice-sdk-integration/references/entity-fields.md#provenance-provenance) |

## Warnings

The documentation's production-quality checklist, or a mistake it warns is accepted and then silently lost. `takgw preflight -strict` exits 1 on these too.

| Rule | Requires | Sources |
|---|---|---|
| `known-fields` | Every JSON key is a field the installed Go SDK declares at that place, spelled exactly; an unknown key is accepted and silently dropped. | [Integration guide: the Any-typed enum trap](https://github.com/anduril/lattice-sdk-ai/blob/7a376d8188a874e2dfeccc85847edbc153aac562/lattice-plugin/skills/lattice-sdk-integration/references/enums.md)<br>[Go SDK v5.5.0: types.go](https://github.com/anduril/lattice-sdk-go/blob/v5.5.0/types.go) |
| `source-update-time-set` | provenance.sourceUpdateTime is set. Lattice keys update events off it. | [Integration guide: Provenance](https://github.com/anduril/lattice-sdk-ai/blob/7a376d8188a874e2dfeccc85847edbc153aac562/lattice-plugin/skills/lattice-sdk-integration/references/entity-fields.md#provenance-provenance)<br>[Go SDK v5.5.0: Provenance.SourceUpdateTime](https://github.com/anduril/lattice-sdk-go/blob/v5.5.0/types.go#L14672-L14676) |
| `source-update-time-increases` | provenance.sourceUpdateTime is not earlier than the same entity's previous update. The documentation doesn't say how the server treats a time that moves backward, so this is a warning. | [Go SDK v5.5.0: Provenance.SourceUpdateTime](https://github.com/anduril/lattice-sdk-go/blob/v5.5.0/types.go#L14672-L14676) |
| `template-set` | ontology.template is set. Without it, the per-template rules can't be checked. | [Integration guide: Required by template](https://github.com/anduril/lattice-sdk-ai/blob/7a376d8188a874e2dfeccc85847edbc153aac562/lattice-plugin/skills/lattice-sdk-integration/references/entity-fields.md#required-by-template) |
| `track-quality-set` | A TEMPLATE_TRACK entity sets tracked.trackQualityWrapper; the guide calls it required for a well-formed track and suggests 2 when the source has no quality signal. | [Integration guide: Track quality](https://github.com/anduril/lattice-sdk-ai/blob/7a376d8188a874e2dfeccc85847edbc153aac562/lattice-plugin/skills/lattice-sdk-integration/references/entity-fields.md#track-quality--tracked)<br>[Integration guide: Production-quality fields](https://github.com/anduril/lattice-sdk-ai/blob/7a376d8188a874e2dfeccc85847edbc153aac562/lattice-plugin/skills/lattice-sdk-integration/references/entity-fields.md#production-quality-fields) |
| `symbology-set` | symbology.milStd2525C.sidc is set. The guide's checklist says always. | [Integration guide: Production-quality fields](https://github.com/anduril/lattice-sdk-ai/blob/7a376d8188a874e2dfeccc85847edbc153aac562/lattice-plugin/skills/lattice-sdk-integration/references/entity-fields.md#production-quality-fields)<br>[Integration guide: Symbology](https://github.com/anduril/lattice-sdk-ai/blob/7a376d8188a874e2dfeccc85847edbc153aac562/lattice-plugin/skills/lattice-sdk-integration/references/entity-fields.md#symbology--symbology) |
| `sidc-format` | symbology.milStd2525C.sidc is 15 characters of upper-case letters, digits and dashes. | [Integration guide: Symbology](https://github.com/anduril/lattice-sdk-ai/blob/7a376d8188a874e2dfeccc85847edbc153aac562/lattice-plugin/skills/lattice-sdk-integration/references/entity-fields.md#symbology--symbology) |
| `sidc-matches-milview` | In a warfighting SIDC (first character S), the affiliation (second character) agrees with milView.disposition and the battle dimension (third) with milView.environment. The guide's mapping is extended with each disposition's other MIL-STD-2525C identities, such as P for pending and J for joker. | [Integration guide: Symbology](https://github.com/anduril/lattice-sdk-ai/blob/7a376d8188a874e2dfeccc85847edbc153aac562/lattice-plugin/skills/lattice-sdk-integration/references/entity-fields.md#symbology--symbology) |
| `classification-set` | dataClassification.default.level is set. The guide's checklist says always, with CLASSIFICATION_LEVELS_UNCLASSIFIED if nothing else. | [Integration guide: Production-quality fields](https://github.com/anduril/lattice-sdk-ai/blob/7a376d8188a874e2dfeccc85847edbc153aac562/lattice-plugin/skills/lattice-sdk-integration/references/entity-fields.md#production-quality-fields)<br>[Integration guide: Data classification](https://github.com/anduril/lattice-sdk-ai/blob/7a376d8188a874e2dfeccc85847edbc153aac562/lattice-plugin/skills/lattice-sdk-integration/references/entity-fields.md#data-classification--data_classification) |
| `asset-health-set` | A TEMPLATE_ASSET entity sets health.healthStatus and health.connectionStatus. The guide's checklist says always. | [Integration guide: Production-quality fields](https://github.com/anduril/lattice-sdk-ai/blob/7a376d8188a874e2dfeccc85847edbc153aac562/lattice-plugin/skills/lattice-sdk-integration/references/entity-fields.md#production-quality-fields)<br>[Integration guide: TEMPLATE_ASSET additional fields](https://github.com/anduril/lattice-sdk-ai/blob/7a376d8188a874e2dfeccc85847edbc153aac562/lattice-plugin/skills/lattice-sdk-integration/references/entity-fields.md#template_asset-additional-fields) |
| `asset-sensors-set` | A TEMPLATE_ASSET entity declares at least one sensor with a sensorType. The guide's checklist says always: at least the asset's primary sensing capability. | [Integration guide: Production-quality fields](https://github.com/anduril/lattice-sdk-ai/blob/7a376d8188a874e2dfeccc85847edbc153aac562/lattice-plugin/skills/lattice-sdk-integration/references/entity-fields.md#production-quality-fields)<br>[Integration guide: TEMPLATE_ASSET additional fields](https://github.com/anduril/lattice-sdk-ai/blob/7a376d8188a874e2dfeccc85847edbc153aac562/lattice-plugin/skills/lattice-sdk-integration/references/entity-fields.md#template_asset-additional-fields) |

## Notes

Notes about coverage: requirements this checker does not model, and so cannot vouch for.

| Rule | Requires | Sources |
|---|---|---|
| `unchecked-template-rules` | TEMPLATE_GEO needs geoDetails and geoShape, which this checker does not model, so those were not checked. | [Integration guide: Required by template](https://github.com/anduril/lattice-sdk-ai/blob/7a376d8188a874e2dfeccc85847edbc153aac562/lattice-plugin/skills/lattice-sdk-integration/references/entity-fields.md#required-by-template) |
